scope: Actual registered offload status release, HND SI switch/restore and RX timeout pool composition

registration.observed: wlc_bmac_init writes offload argument to HW+0x534 and callback address to HW+0x538 when pub byte0x1c1 is nonzero
registration.pool_relationship: Pool base HW+0x524; callback and argument offsets0x14/0x10. Attach pseudocode passes this base to dma_sts_mp_set; its assembly stores DI+0x100.
registration.implementation: A matching known callback AND argument label compose the real child; runtime pool acquisition/registration itself is not implemented.
